item.title: FIRST Tech Challenge | REAPR
item.description: I founded REAPR after being rejected from my school’s FRC team, building a student-led robotics program that combined competitive engineering with a deliberate effort to make robotics more accessible.

item.title: FRC | Software Development & Strategy Lead

item.title: GSET | Undergraduate Research Scholar
item.description: Selected as 1 of 64 statewide applicants. Worked on autonomous path tracking with a five-person research team.
